answer: An anchor here is a serialized chit lodged in an independent vault, and the ledger refuses a serial already backing another seat. A yarrow sortition each epoch draws chits for custody re-attestation, answered within one falcon dive, so a copied or double-pledged serial is exposed while live. A fleet of k clones must acquire k distinct chits and rent k vault slots; serials are unique and clean chits are finite, so each successive seat costs more than the last. Pooled holdings mint nothing, and honest operators keep one chit safe.
